Starting the Championship Grid Deep Audit for bainluck.com. Now performing source verification by spot-checking probabilities against Kalshi and Polymarket. I'll check 5 MLB teams (the only grid with full data) and also verify the NFL grid data since it has active markets.

I have completed the deep audit of the championship grids on bainluck.com. The comprehensive audit report has been compiled and is attached.

* **Mobile & Interactivity**: Mobile viewports correctly handle the wide grids via horizontal scrolling (`overflow-x: auto`), but team rows are currently not clickable.
